data.one_liner: Integrates Datadog Session Replay into Flutter apps via FFI.
data.what_it_does: Adds a SessionReplayCapture widget and a DatadogSessionReplay instance that records user sessions for debugging and analytics. It works with Datadog RUM and supports sampling, manual start/stop, and hybrid app scenarios.
use_when: You need real‑user session replay for debugging or analytics.
You already use datadog_flutter_plugin and want to capture UI interactions.
You want deterministic sampling of sessions for replay.”
